null_event_shuffle: independent within participant; participant order p01, p02, p03, p04, p05; seed reset per omission or full sequence control
visit_null: shuffle event labels, then collapse maximal consecutive basin runs within each participant
geometry_null: common row/column basin-label permutation of successor distance matrix; two-sided Pearson; draws with replacement
BH_families: K basins within assignment and condition; separate persistence count and probability families
zero_outgoing_rows: retain zero rows; solve successor matrix without imputation
absent_basin_after_omission: retain frozen K; omission-specific geometry not estimable if any centroid absent
comparison_scope: conditional descriptive sensitivity; no downstream selection of assignments
